note: Transcribed from the scan (Machen 1923 plates, January 1924 printing, pp. 27-28). Greek as printed (no misprints found; the 1927 corrected printing has the same text). Answers written for this course: English for part I, Greek for part II (every Greek form checked by build/greek_corpus.py). English prompts with thou/ye are given as you (sg.)/you (pl.); the book's wording is in data.book_prompt.

items.answer: You (sg.) write a word to an apostle.

accept: Thou writest a word to an apostle.

items.answer: A brother says a word to an apostle.
A brother of apostles knows a law.

items.prompt: δοῦλοι γινώσκουσι νόμον καὶ λαμβάνουσι δῶρα.
items.answer: Servants know a law and take gifts.
We take gifts and have brothers.

items.prompt: ἀποστόλοις καὶ δούλοις λέγομεν λόγους θανάτου.
items.answer: We say words of death to apostles and servants.

items.prompt: ἀδελφοὶ καὶ δοῦλοι γινώσκουσιν καὶ βλέπουσιν ἱερὰ καὶ δῶρα.
items.answer: Brothers and servants know and see temples and gifts.

items.prompt: γράφει ἀπόστολος νόμον καὶ λέγει λόγους υἱοῖς δούλου.
items.answer: An apostle writes a law and says words to sons of a servant.

items.prompt: υἱοὶ ἀποστόλων λέγουσι λόγους καὶ λύουσι δούλους.
items.answer: Sons of apostles say words and loose servants.

items.prompt: A servant is writing a law.
An apostle sees a servant and a gift.
Servants and sons are saying a word to a brother.
items.answer: δοῦλοι καὶ υἱοὶ λέγουσι λόγον ἀδελφῷ.

items.prompt: Men see words and gifts of a brother and houses of apostles and sons.
items.answer: ἄνθρωποι βλέπουσι λόγους καὶ δῶρα ἀδελφοῦ καὶ οἴκους ἀποστόλων καὶ υἱῶν.

items.prompt: Words and laws we write to brethren; a word of death we say to a servant.
items.answer: λόγους καὶ νόμους γράφομεν ἀδελφοῖς· λόγον θανάτου λέγομεν δούλῳ.

items.prompt: A son is seeing temples and houses.
You (sg.) take an apostle’s gift (= a gift of an apostle).

data.book_prompt: Thou takest an apostle’s gift (= a gift of an apostle).

items.prompt: You (sg.) are writing a brother’s word to a servant.

data.book_prompt: Thou art writing a brother’s word to a servant.

items.prompt: I loose servants and say words to sons and brothers.
items.answer: λύω δούλους καὶ λέγω λόγους υἱοῖς καὶ ἀδελφοῖς.

items.prompt: They know laws and teach servants of an apostle.
items.answer: γινώσκουσι νόμους καὶ διδάσκουσι δούλους ἀποστόλου.
